production.languagePolicy: German lesson narration; every Arabic-origin word, including names, Islamic terms, Ṣidq, Ṣiddīq, Sūrat titles, Ṣaḥīḥ, Muslim and greetings, requires verified native Fuṣḥā phonetics and owner-audited whole-clip hearing. Human Qurʾān recitation only. No global unverified PLS injection.

ownerPronunciationHold.reason: Owner rejected 2026-11-11: GLOBAL Arabic-word pronunciation across all Kids Academy speech (including Ṣidq / aṣ-Ṣiddīq, Surah names, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Qurʾān, Islamic terms, greetings and names). Previously identified source citation numbers must remain visible-only. Do not spend credits or publish until lexicon and individual phonetic audio are explicitly owner-reviewed.
ownerPronunciationHold.appliesTo: EVERY KIDS Academy utterance and EVERY Arabic-origin term, regardless of script, romanization, diacritics, role, age, source or lesson; all V4 staging pipelines.
ownerPronunciationHold.approvalRequired: review each distinct Arabic term against Arabic-Fuṣḥā owner master library; listen to entire mixed-language utterance, validate correct phonemes/gemination/long vowels, then explicit owner approval.
ownerPronunciationHold.knownContrast: Ṣidq (صِدْق) means truthfulness; aṣ-Ṣiddīq (الصِّدِّيق) is a different word/title. Never substitute or pronounce one as the other.
ownerPronunciationHold.audioCorrectionWithoutNewCredit: audit and stage text-only first; paid re-recording only after term-by-term master comparison and owner approval

speechListeningChecks: same vocal character as Adam/Idris/Muhammad approved story audio
no breathing artifacts, abrupt endings or distorted pitch
no speed-shift from native generated recording
All Arabic-origin terms: independently match each word against owner master lexicon AND phonetic reference. No Latin TTS alias or machine QA alone may approve.
